name: Mateo Alvarez
summary: Staff backend engineer with 10 years building distributed Go systems over PostgreSQL and Kafka, deployed on Kubernetes with Terraform. Led system design and scalability work for multi-region services and mentored senior engineers, with a strong observability practice.
strengths: Deep Go and distributed systems expertise
Kubernetes and Terraform delivery at scale
gaps: Recent focus is architecture-heavy, less day-to-day feature coding
resumeText: Staff Backend Engineer at Andes Systems owning the architecture of distributed Go services across multiple regions, with event-driven flows over Kafka and PostgreSQL as the source of truth. I drive system design, latency, and consistency work, and standardize observability across the platform. Earlier I scaled services at Lago Plata and began my career writing backend services at Tercera Labs.
